acquisition method: After the survey scan, the 20 most intense precursor ions were selected for MS/MS fragmentation.
alkylation reagent: carbamidomethylation of cysteines as a fixed modification
collision energy: Fragmentation was performed with a normalized collision energy of 27 eV
enrichment method: the entire bands were excised from the gel for their analysis by mass spectrometry
fractionation method: the entire bands were excised from the gel for their analysis by mass spectrometry
instrument: MS analysis was performed via a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: Different profiles of proteins secreted by the fungus grown in the culture media or in the aqueous filtrate were observed through SDS‒PAGE and LC‒MS/MS analysis identifying 99 and 304 proteins, respectively.
